human: azopt contains brinzolamide which belongs to a group of medicines called carbonic anhydrase inhibitors. it reduces pressure within the eye. azopt eye drops are used to treat high pressure in the eye. this pressure can lead to an illness called glaucoma. if the pressure in the eye is too high, it can damage your sight.
